def _basis(log_taus, past, hold, features, dt, times, act, plateau):
    taus = np.exp(log_taus)
    age = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.0]
    a, q, r = (age[:, None] / taus, dt[:, None] / taus, times[:, None] / taus)
    ea, eq, er = (np.exp(-a), np.exp(-q), np.exp(-r))
    memory = ea * -np.expm1(-q)
    z = past @ memory
    dz = past @ (a * memory - q * ea * eq)
    gap = hold[:, None] - z
    step = -np.expm1(-r)
    prony = gap[:, None, :] * step
    phi = np.broadcast_to(np.log1p(times) if plateau else times, (len(past), len(times)))
    drive = act * hold
    curve = np.concatenate((prony, phi[:, :, None] * features[:, None, :], (drive[:, None] * step[:, 0])[..., None], ((act * z[:, 0])[:, None] * phi)[..., None]), axis=2)
    rate = np.column_stack((gap / taus, features, drive / taus[0], act * z[:, 0]))
    dc = -dz[:, None, :] * step - gap[:, None, :] * r * er
    dr = (-dz - gap) / taus
    dc_extra = np.stack((-drive[:, None] * (r * er)[:, 0], (act * dz[:, 0])[:, None] * phi), axis=-1)
    dr_extra = np.column_stack((-drive / taus[0], act * dz[:, 0]))
    return (curve, rate, np.concatenate((dc, dc_extra), axis=-1), np.column_stack((dr, dr_extra)))

def _design(log_tau, past, hold, features, dt, times, act):
    tau = np.exp(log_tau)
    age = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.0]
    z = past @ (np.exp(-age[:, None] / tau) * -np.expm1(-dt[:, None] / tau))
    gap = hold[:, None] - z
    step = -np.expm1(-times[:, None] / tau)
    phi = np.log1p(times)
    curve = np.concatenate((gap[:, None, :] * step, features[:, None, :] * phi[None, :, None], (act * hold)[:, None, None] * step[None, :, :1], (act * z[:, 0])[:, None, None] * phi[None, :, None]), axis=2)
    rate = np.column_stack((gap / tau, features, act * hold / tau[0], act * z[:, 0]))
    return (curve, rate)

def _profile_fit(past, hold, features, dt, times, act, curves, rates, rate_weight=1.0):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    curve_ok, rate_ok = (np.isfinite(curves), np.isfinite(rates))
    target = np.r_[curves[curve_ok], rate_weight * rates[rate_ok]]

    def profile(log_tau, weights_only=False):
        curve, rate = _design(log_tau, past, hold, features, dt, times, act)
        design = np.concatenate((curve[curve_ok], rate_weight * rate[rate_ok]))
        weights = np.linalg.lstsq(design, target, rcond=None)[0]
        return weights if weights_only else design @ weights - target
    best = min((least_squares(profile, np.log(start), bounds=(np.log([0.02, 0.04]), np.log([40.0, 100.0])), diff_step=2e-05, max_nfev=100) for start in ((0.5, 4.0), (0.2, 2.0), (1.0, 10.0))), key=lambda fit: fit.cost)
    log_tau = best.x
    if not np.any(act):
        log_tau = np.sort(log_tau)
    return (log_tau, profile(log_tau, weights_only=True))
